'''House Petro''' was an artistocratic family that was among a group of settlers that went to live on worlds in and around the nebula [[Thull's Shroud/Legends|Thull's Shroud]], in about [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The Petro settled in the [[Kalgo system/Legends|Kalgo system]], on the many [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalgo 13]], in a region that would later become known as the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

House Petro also controlled [[Tranthellix]], agricultural world [[Kamur]] and the forested world [[Usnia]], which they made into a nature reserve. They also had mining operations on the desert world [[Jalarren]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Gyla Petro]] was a member of the house.<ref name="Endnotes for SW:TEA (p5/5)">{{Blog|danwallace|147|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 5 of 5)}}</ref>
